descriptionChirho: A military siege structure erected against a fortified city, referring to earthwork ramps, towers, or bulwarks used in ancient Near Eastern warfare. All six occurrences describe the same type of siege installation with minor translation variation. Eng 'siege-wall', spa 'torre de asedio / cerco', hin 'morche / damdama / gherabandi', arb 'mitrasah / hisn / sur', kor 'mangdae / powi-dam', swa 'ngome / boma la kuzingira'.
